verdict.rationale: Jules has a documented public API at developers.google.com/jules/api. That page includes API-key setup, an optional automationMode field, and step-by-step example calls for sending messages and approving plans. These are copyable examples, but nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser 'try it' console, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec on jules.google. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer/try-it console, in-browser runnable examples, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent corroboration of the reference's quality.
